game_title: Stack Of Plates – Cracked Obelisk Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Cracked Obelisk, a cracked obelisk: the rune scholar must handle crypt crawlers while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Cracked Obelisk: a cracked obelisk
core_gameplay_loop: In Cracked Obelisk, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Each round, a new spirit candles challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the stack_balance value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 460 points of spirit candles by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 460, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 10 (extended tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stack_balance changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crypt crawlers in Cracked Obelisk.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 460 within 57 seconds.
